# Drone TikTok Real-Motion Brief V3

## Product
Screen Remote Foldable Drone

## Goal
Create a short vertical TikTok-style product ad that feels like a real drone commercial, not a slideshow.

## Required Structure
1. Hook
2. Takeoff shot
3. Stable hover shot
4. Dual camera switching shot
5. Remote control operation shot
6. CTA close

## Target Format
- 22 to 28 seconds
- 1080x1920 vertical
- English voiceover
- English subtitles
- Fast-paced direct response style

## Verified Claims Only
- Screen remote control
- No mobile phone required
- Dual cameras
- Dual camera switching
- 90-degree angle adjustment
- One-click takeoff
- One-click landing
- Headless mode
- Optical flow hovering
- 3.7V high-capacity battery
- LCD remote screen
- Included accessories shown in the product images
- Carry case included
- Two batteries shown
- Spare propellers shown
- Propeller guards shown
- SD card shown
- USB card reader shown
- Emergency stop button shown on the remote guide
- 360-degree tumbling shown on the remote guide
- Speed switching shown on the remote guide
- Photograph / video playback controls shown on the remote guide

## Guardrails
- Do not claim GPS if not verified
- Do not claim obstacle avoidance performance if not verified beyond visible labeling
- Do not claim professional cinema footage
- Do not invent range, resolution, tracking, or wind resistance
- Do not claim obstacle avoidance works in real flight unless separately validated
- Do not claim battery runtime unless separately validated
- Do not claim camera resolution unless separately validated
